mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong household demand for housing, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above its 12-month moving average signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which together drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 at 16205.6 (asof t-6mo), INDPRO at 106.6617 (asof t-2mo)
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 decline and INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase, a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals improving job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during labor market recovery when UNRATE < 5.0%.
